approved: owner 2026-10-21 (decisions D21 and D21a in PMIC-verified-layer-deployment.md)
applies_to: bundles whose obligations.policy_id is tcs6-obligations/1.0 (pilot: Lido, Maker/Sky, Compound; the other protocols keep the pre-policy rule until curated under this policy)

classes.counted: approved, unconditional and owed from treasury assets (including the protocol's own token when paid from tokens the treasury already holds): obligations.items, deducted from treasury capital
classes.disclosed: voluntary, ex gratia, conditional, contingent, disputed or unconfirmed commitments, and own-token commitments settled through new issuance or non-treasury supply: obligations.disclosed, shown in the report, never deducted until approved and unconditional
classes.cash_use: future operating budgets for services not yet delivered: cash_uses_12m (runway), not obligations

evidence_age.rule: current while the report's period end (report_date) is within max_age_days of as_of, or while it was published (publication_date) within max_age_days and governance records were checked for anything newer (governance_checked_through on or after publication_date, itself within max_age_days of as_of)

materiality.rule: each missing checklist item and each material conflict is assessed: a curated upper bound (unvalued_bounds_usd) at or under both thresholds is non_material; above either it is material; at or above critical_share_threshold of counted treasury it is critical; no bound is undetermined, which is never treated as immaterial

audit: every report under this policy carries obligations_policy with the pre-policy score and status, the score effect in points, the materiality reasons and the disclosed commitments
